_comment: Checkpoint modes for the QML Lab autonomy ladder (docs/lab, D4/D5).
HUMAN_APPROVE blocks until a person signs. HUMAN_SPOTCHECK proceeds; a sample is reviewed within 48 h.
AGENT proceeds; the decision is logged; escalations still fire.
A checkpoint steps down one mode after `retire_rule.consecutive_runs` sign-offs with no material change
AND all of its `evals` passing on the current lab_version. Only Tsahi approves a step-down
(python -m lab.tools.autonomy step-down). Any material finding restores the previous mode automatically.
CP2 (freeze) and CP5 (promotion) are permanently HUMAN_APPROVE.
